# spx Provider

The SPX provider is used to interact with the Superphenix API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) SPX API Token. Can also be set via the `SPX_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `az` (String) Availability Zone. Can also be set via the `SPX_AZ` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) SPX API Endpoint. Can also be set via the `SPX_API_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `orga_id` (String) Organization ID. Can also be set via the `SPX_ORGA_ID` environment variable.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Can also be set via the `SPX_PROJECT_ID` environment variable.
